patthana21.3:1.1: ceva na hetuvippayutto ca na kusalo dhammo hetussa ceva hetusampayuttassa ca kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo, (saṃkhittaṃ). (nava pañhā kātabbā)
patthana21.3:2.1: na hetu ceva na hetuvippayutto ca na ahetuko dhammo hetussa ceva hetu sampayuttassa ca ahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (saṃkhittaṃ). (nava pañhā kātabbā).
patthana21.3:3.1: na hetu ceva na he vippayutto ca na abyākato dhammo hetussa ceva hetusampayuttassa ca abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo. tīṇi, (nava pañhā kātabbā). na hetuṃ na sahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ
